headline: Frequent Reworks in rich/text.py
diagnosis: The file rich/text.py is undergoing frequent reworks primarily due to issues related to whitespace handling and style management. The recurring themes in the commit messages indicate a lack of clarity and consistency in how text styles and whitespace are processed, leading to multiple fixes and reverts.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the whitespace handling logic, particularly around the soft_wrap functionality, to ensure it aligns with expected behavior.
Standardize the handling of text styles across the file and related modules, ensuring that all components respect the text.style attribute consistently.
Implement comprehensive unit tests that cover edge cases for both whitespace handling and style application to prevent future regressions.
Establish a clear documentation guideline for any changes made to rich/text.py to improve clarity and reduce the need for subsequent fixes.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the team to mitigate bus factor risks.
